akiko - evals: heads-up: pavo-v3-q4 bring-up failing locale smoke for ja->ko and ko->ja. METEOR dropped a lot and outputs show strange \u201cideographic-space\u201d insertion and ZWJ collapse on names.
sam - infra: any quick diffs vs fp32? config or tokenizer changes?
akiko - evals: running a tiny repro and attaching samples.

```bash
# repro (local smoke)
python tooling/run_eval.py --model pavo-v3-q4 --task translate_ja_ko --input tests/smoke/ja_names.txt --batch 1
```

fp32: "\u6771\u4eac
\u30bf\u30cb\u30fc\u304c\u6765\u307e\u3057\u305f" -> "도쿄 타니가 왔습니다"
q4:  "\u6771\u4eac \u200b\u30bf\u30cb\u30fc\u304c\u6765\u307e\u3057\u305f" -> "도쿄타니가왔습니다"

(note: q4 removed spaces between tokens in target but inserted a ZERO-WIDTH SPACE \u200b after ideograph in source in detok)

deploy-bot: pavo-v3-q4 nightly | task translate_ja_ko | METEOR: 0.42 (-0.18) | BLEU: 16.1 (-4.7) | samples: 40

lee - tokenizers: can you print token sequence + decoded strings for both bundles? suspect normalizer or pre-tokenization rule mismatch (ideographic-space handling).
akiko - evals: did that. sample below. tokens shown as [token:id].

fp32 tokens: ["\u6771\u4eac":2012] ["\u30bf\u30cb\u30fc":4590] ["\u304c":786] ["\u6765\u307e\u3057\u305f":3244]
fp32 detok: "\u6771\u4eac\u30bf\u30cb\u30fc\u304c\u6765\u307e\u3057\u305f" (-> "도쿄 타니가 왔습니다")

q4 tokens: ["\u6771\u4eac":2012] ["\u30bf\u30cb\u30fc":4590] ["\u304c":786] ["\u6765\u307e\u3057\u305f":3244]
q4 detok (runtime): "\u6771\u4eac \u200b\u30bf\u30cb\u30fc\u304c\u6765\u307e\u3057\u305f" (-> "도쿄타니가왔습니다")

lee - tokenizers: tokens identical & ids match. So problem is detokenizer/normalizer step. Packaging for q4 includes tokenizer.json but our normalizer.json (NFKC rules + ZWJ exceptions) is missing from the bundle; runtime falls back to generic normalizer which inserts U+200B for ideographic joining in some languages.
sam - infra: can we confirm file list in bundle?
akiko - evals: bundle inspect:

```json
{"files": ["token_map.bin","tokenizer.json","vocab.bin"]}
```

no normalizer.json present.

ops-maya: opened INF-3521 to prevent bundles without normalizer.json for multilingual models. Rolling pavo-v3-q4 back from canary.

lee - tokenizers: we should also make a small unit smoke that decodes three canonical samples (ja->ko, ko->ja, zh->en) using the provided normalizer.json and assert expected ASCII spacing and ZWJ behaviour. I'll PR to tokenizers repo.

akiko - evals: quick experiment: loaded fp32 normalizer + applied to q4 detok path and re-decoded.

```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer, normalizers
fp_norm = json.load(open('bundles/pavo-v3-fp32/normalizer.json'))
q_tokenizer = Tokenizer.from_file('bundles/pavo-v3-q4/tokenizer.json')
# hack: apply fp32 normalizer config before decode
q_tokenizer._normalizer = normalizers.Sequence(...)  # pseudo
print(q_tokenizer.decode([2012,4590,786,3244]))
# -> "\u6771\u4eac\u30bf\u30cb\u30fc\u304c\u6765\u307e\u3057\u305f"
```

akiko - evals: with proper normalizer, translations re-align; METEOR returns near-baseline.

sam - infra: we'll patch the bundle creation script to copy normalizer.json and add preflight checks (decode canonical samples) before publishing. Also adding an integrity check in model registry that lists required files per model profile.

ops-maya: rolling rollback complete. INF-3521 created and assigned to packaging.

lee - tokenizers: follow-up PR to add canonical detok smoke + a note in model onboarding checklist to ensure normalizer is present.
akiko - evals: good. after packaging fix + re-run, I'll rebaseline and post new metrics. leaving thread open until re-run validated. :eyes:
